comment: The reason prefixes GET /api/tos/projection may emit, and the UI state each maps to. Shared by services/dashboard/routes/tos_projection.py's tests and strategy-builder-ui/src/lib/dashboard/tos.ts's tests. Both sides assert this file, but only the Python side is CI-gated: this repository has no node job (no setup-node, vitest or tsc in .github/workflows), so adding a prefix here without a projectionState branch passes CI and lands in the UI as 'unknown'. No reason ever carries a value read from the projection file.
